name: PR detail shows the seeded Intent card
description: From PR #482, confirm the Intent card renders from the seeded pr_intent row on the default Overview tab (an in-scope item, a risk area and the confidence label), then switch to the Agent runs tab and confirm the card is there too, next to the seeded run's verdict. The card is read from GET /pulls/:id/intent: no model call, because the flow never starts a review and never presses 'Derive intent' or 'Re-run intent detection'. The summary sentence is not asserted: the seeded PR description contains the same sentence. The literal strings come from e2e/specs/seed-fixtures.md ('PR #482 has a seeded intent'). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
